name: QtilerAuth
description: Adds user management, JWT auth, and project-level permissions. Uses SQLite for ACID-safe storage.

en.description: Adds authentication, roles, and project access control for secure Qtiler deployments.
readme: Create and manage users, roles, account status, passwords, and API keys.
Set projects as public/private and assign user-specific private access.
Supports session cookie, bearer token, basic auth, and api_key workflows.
Use it as the security base layer for dashboard and service endpoints.

Production behind IIS/URL Rewrite/ARR with DNS and HTTPS: set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to the external HTTPS URL, keep QTILER_TRUST_PROXY=loopback when IIS and Qtiler run on the same host, enable QTILER_ENABLE_HSTS=1 only after HTTPS is verified, and set QTILER_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the trusted public origins.

IIS must terminate TLS with a valid certificate, redirect HTTP to HTTPS, proxy to http://127.0.0.1:3000, preserve the original Host, and forward X-Forwarded-Proto=https, X-Forwarded-Host, and X-Forwarded-For. Disable WebDAV or explicitly allow PATCH/DELETE if IIS filters those methods.

Recommended production hardening: AUTH_CAPTCHA_PROVIDER=pow, AUTH_API_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE set to a finite value such as 1000, AUTH_STORE_PLAINTEXT_API_KEYS=0 for hash-only API key storage, and QTILER_WMTS_REQUIRE_AUTH=1 if anonymous global WMTS discovery should be blocked. Use QTILER_CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS=1 only when a different trusted origin needs cookie sessions.

Markera projekt som publika/privata och tilldela anvandarspecifik privat atkomst.
Stodjer sessionscookie, bearer-token, basic auth och api_key-floden.
